cohort: 61 needles: semantic AND pool_absent on the v09x bed
bed: erb_blob.db (829k) -- a DIFFERENT BASELINES row from v09x
control: BM25 ranks 51..1000 of the same shortlist query

decision_rule.KILL: dense tail rescues <= the BM25 tail at every R in {1,3,6,12} -- a dense producer buys nothing the cheap control does not already buy
decision_rule.PASS_TO_BED_ARM: dense - bm25 >= +6 of the cohort at some R <= 12 AND the held-out half shows the same SIGN. n=61 is too small to gate on a split magnitude, so the split is a robustness check, not the bar.

known_confounds: Cohort membership was fixed on v09x; pool-absence is re-derived on this bed and needles that are NOT pool-absent here are reported separately rather than silently included.
Gold with no stored vector is unreachable by dense at any depth and is counted separately.
This measures REACH (does gold enter the tail), not delivery. Blend, tier, trim and session elision all run after.
bed_access: read-only (mode=ro), no index created, no pipeline run
